validation_vs_fg.leakage_check: def_value uses as-of-prospect listed position + frame (BMI) + age only; realized MLB position is never an input

xfv_swap_gate.protocol: forward-chained OOS (tools/xfv_ml_lab.py), hit side; lean = shipped xFV set
xfv_swap_gate.verdict: REJECTED (loss, not shipped): def_value REGRESSES the shipped lean xFV model on every gate (pooled rho -0.0040, within-tier -0.0208, fringe -0.0201). Even a far better defensive predictor (0.68 vs FG 0.28) is flat-to-negative on xFV's offense-dominated first-6yr-WAR target -- the binding constraint is the TARGET, not measurement quality (re-confirms wills-models-for-xfv-audit + the 2026-06-29 def-feature-class re-test).

alternative_use: def_value validates as a better-than-FG prospect-defense predictor; its lane is the surfaces where defense IS a measured WAR component (MLB Projections / farm / display), NOT the offense-dominated xFV ranker. See def-prior-mlb-projections.

proj_lgbm_swap_gate.protocol: forward-chained OOS (tools/def_feature_backtest.py), joined by mlbam as a pre-MLB prior on top of the shipped pos_adj_prior; coverage 14.7% of corpus hitters
proj_lgbm_swap_gate.verdict: REJECTED (loss, not shipped): every variant REGRESSES the holdout (pooled +0.0009..+0.0028, star +0.025..+0.035) with dev ~flat -- inconsistent sign = noise. For MLB players the REALIZED positional value (shipped pos_adj_prior, bWAR runs_position) already captures def_value; the prospect-era prediction is redundant + low-coverage (14.7%), and the entropy signal does not help. def_value's positional-value core is thus ALREADY in the projection model via pos_adj_prior.
